entries.text: For the first time... I feel time like a heartbeat, the seconds pumping in my breast like a reckoning, the numinous mysteries that once seemed so distant and unreal... Threatening clarity in the presence of a truth... Entertained not in youth, but only in its passage. I feel these words as if their meaning... Were weight being lifted from me, knowing that you will read them and share my burden... As I have come to trust no other. That you should know my heart, look into it, finding there the memory and experience that belong to you, that are you, is a comfort to me now as I feel the tethers loose... And the prospects darken... For the continuance of a journey that began not so long ago, and which began again with a faith shaken and strengthened... By your convictions. If not for which I might never have been so strong now... As I cross to face you and look at you incomplete, hoping that you will forgive me... For not making the rest of the journey with you.

entries.text: No. I don't think so, Penny.

entries.text: Dana, I want you to get well. You've been such a comfort. You've got to be the one. You can't give up hope.
entries.speaker: Penny Northern

entries.text: I haven't. I won't.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Is she gone? I know what she meant to you. When I came to find you and you weren't in your room, I got scared that something had happened. And I read some of what you wrote.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ sighs ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I didn't want you to read that. I had decided to throw it out. I decided tonight that, um-- that I'm not gonna let this thing beat me. I came into this hospital able to work. And that's how I'm leaving.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Byers tell you about dr. Scanlon?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Yes.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: He may very well have killed those women.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That will have to be proven-- if we find him.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: When we find him. Something was done to you-- something you're just beginning to remember. You can't quite figure it out, but it can be explained, and it will be explained. And no matter what you think as a scientist or doctor, there is a way and you will find it... To save yourself.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ sighs ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder, I can't kid myself. People live with cancer. They carry on. And so will I. You know, I've got things to finish... To prove to myself, to my family. But for my own reasons.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Come on back. The truth will save you, Scully. I think it'll save both of us.
